_comment: Chest ImaGenome SILVER set: the full auto-generated scene-graph release (~240k chest X-rays) with official train/valid/test splits, anatomical bounding boxes, and per-region findings. An annotation layer over MIMIC-CXR (PhysioNet, credentialed access + DUA); ships no pixels. Images are read from the MIMIC-CXR DICOM tree, keyed by dicom_id. Source: https://physionet.org/content/chest-imagenome/1.0.0/
base_image_dir: MIMIC-CXR DICOM files/ root (children are p10/, p11/, ...), e.g. /data/MIMIC-CXR-V2-AWS/files/

primary_csv._comment: Not a single CSV. The harmonizer reads silver_dataset/scene_graph.zip (one JSON per image: objects=boxes, attributes=per-region findings), filtered to the chosen split via silver_dataset/splits/<split>.csv (excluding images_to_avoid.csv).

image_path._comment: From the split CSV 'path' column; 'files/' stripped so it is relative to base_image_dir. Ends in .dcm.

labels._comment: No image-level classification vector. Findings are PER BOX (see bboxes/custom_preprocessing), not aggregated to image level.

separate_csv._comment: Per-region findings parsed from each scene-graph JSON's 'attributes' (relation 'yes').

uncertain_handling._comment: Only positive (relation 'yes') findings in categories anatomicalfinding/disease/tubesandlines/device are kept; nlp and technicalassessment excluded.

bboxes._comment: Up to ~36 anatomical-region boxes per image (all regions, including finding-free ones). Stored as parallel per-box lists: bbox (normalized [y_min,y_max,x_min,x_max]), bbox_labels (anatomy region name), bbox_findings (that region's findings, '|'-joined). Coords normalized against original DICOM Rows/Columns.

extra_init_params.annotation_dir: Chest ImaGenome release root (contains silver_dataset/), e.g. /data/CHEST-IMAGENOME/
extra_init_params.output_bbox: Default True; boxes are this dataset's sole annotation.

custom_preprocessing: Per-box findings are carried in the harmonized 'bbox_findings' column via the harmonizer's EXTRA_OUTPUT_COLS (anatomy in bbox_labels, findings in bbox_findings) - NOT aggregated to an image-level cls vector. The dataset sets SUPPORTS_BBOX_FINDINGS=True, so with output_bbox=True all three (bbox, bbox_labels, bbox_findings) are threaded into each sample, index-aligned through augmentation; the app labels each box 'anatomy: findings'. Instantiating a full split parses scene_graph.zip and reads one DICOM header per image for bbox normalization (cached by the harmonizer's save()). MIMIC-derived, PhysioNet data: never commit the harmonized DataFrame, saved CSVs, or images.
